name: oniguruma
description: Regular expression library supporting multiple encodings and regex syntaxes (BRE, ERE, Perl, Python, Java, etc), used by jq, PHP mbstring, and Ruby's regex engine.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
